user.title: Configure a camera
user.description: Connect an RTSP camera, or enter test://pattern as the video URL to try the bridge without a camera. This is an experimental build.

data.camera_id: Camera ID (lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens)
data.name: Camera name
data.software_motion: Detect motion in the camera video

pair.title: Pair with Apple Home
pair.description: In Apple Home, choose Add Accessory → More Options, select this camera and enter {pairing_code}. You can also pair later. HomeKit Secure Video requires your compatible Home hub and iCloud+ plan. Submit to finish the Home Assistant setup.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or authenticate to the engine. Check the URL, token and camera settings.

init.title: Camera video quality
init.description: Set the maximum resolution for live view and recordings. The camera's RTSP feed determines the detail available.
